description: Two small stages in 4HP: one adds a fixed voltage to its input, the other scales its input with a fader

params.text: Adds between -5V and 5V to the voltage at the offset input, despite the maker's tooltip calling it an attenuverter
Scales the voltage at the fader input, from silence at the bottom to the whole of it at the top

inputs.text: The voltage the offset knob is added to; with nothing patched it reads 5V
The voltage the fader scales; with nothing patched it reads 5V

outputs.text: Carries its input plus the offset knob, and the fader result is added to it while the fader output is unpatched
Carries its input scaled by the fader, silent at the bottom and the whole input at the top
